question: highest rated version
final_sql: WITH version_ratings AS (SELECT game, app_version, AVG(CAST(rating AS REAL)) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews WHERE NOT app_version IS NULL GROUP BY game, app_version), ranked_versions AS (SELECT game, app_version, ROUND(avg_rating, 2) AS average_rating, review_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY game ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC) AS rn FROM version_ratings) SELECT game, app_version, average_rating, review_count FROM ranked_versions WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY game LIMIT 500
